name: Skill Based Boss Fights
desc:
Welcome to Skill Based Boss Fights. Fight unique bosses, unlock special classes, and become the most skill based player of all time.

| WARNING: This game is difficult for new players and is not recommended to be played on a mobile device.

[HOTKEYS / Changeable in settings]:
  -  Z + X: Your primary abilities, sometimes C and V for higher tier classes.
  -  Q: Dash where walking

[EXTRA CREDITS / More in game]:
  - Some icons are from the game-icons website.
  - Thank you to our testers for ensuring a quality experience.

[MISC LINKS]:
  - Group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/17118615

Inspired by Boss Fighting Stages.
Contains flashing lights, can be turned off through Reduce Screen Flash setting.
